text: Which statement about uniform continuity is correct?
choices: Uniform continuity is a weaker condition than ordinary continuity
f(x) = x^2 is uniformly continuous on all of R
Every function continuous on an open interval (a,b) is uniformly continuous there
Every function continuous on a closed bounded interval [a,b] is uniformly continuous
explanation: By the Heine-Cantor theorem, continuity on a compact set [a,b] upgrades to uniform continuity. Uniform continuity is stronger, not weaker, than continuity; x^2 fails it on R because the required delta must shrink as x grows; and continuity on an open interval need not be uniform (e.g. 1/x on (0,1)).
